findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context discards the modified config copy
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` makes a copy of `monitor.config`, replaces `schedule_type` with its human-readable display value, but then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) under the `"config"` key. The `config` local is never used, so the monitor context attached to the issue occurrence still carries the raw integer `schedule_type` instead of the display string. This defect is being carried into the new module unchanged; since the code is being relocated anyway it is a good time to return `config` instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`.

findings.title: Public symbols removed from mark_failed without re-export shims
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP`, `SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP` and `SimpleCheckIn` were all module-level names in `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and are now gone (moved and partially renamed). Any other module or test that imports them from this path, or that patches e.g. `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` / `mark_failed_threshold` with `mock.patch`, will now fail at import/patch time (mock.patch raises AttributeError for a missing attribute). No test files are updated in this PR, so please verify (grep for these names across src/ and tests/) and either update call sites/patch targets or keep thin re-export aliases in `mark_failed.py`.
